# Weave.js

> Weave.js is a visual collaborative apps framework: a headless, store-agnostic SDK plus React helpers for building real-time collaborative canvases.

## Framework

- [Application structure](/prerelease/main/application-structure/): Overview of frontend and backend artifacts and their responsibilities
- [Architecture overview](/prerelease/main/architecture/): Deep dive into Weave.js architecture and design principles
- [Contributing](/prerelease/main/contributing/): Want to collaborate? Learn how.

- [v1.0.0](/prerelease/main/release-notes/1.0.0/): Initial stable release of Weave.js
- [v2.0.0](/prerelease/main/release-notes/2.0.0/): Improved scalability when using the Azure Web PubSub store
- [v3.0.0](/prerelease/main/release-notes/3.0.0/): Focus on **performance, architecture flexibility, and cleaner integration APIs**.
- [v4.0.0](/prerelease/main/release-notes/4.0.0/): Focus on unified snapping architecture and custom canvas guides.
- [v5.0.0](/prerelease/main/release-notes/5.0.0/): Focus on **diagramming capabilities, optimistic persistence, and a cleaner store architecture**.
- [Release notes](/prerelease/main/release-notes/): Discover what's new in Weave.js
- [Align Nodes Tool](/prerelease/main/build/actions/align-nodes-tool/): Select nodes and align among them
- [Arrow Tool (deprecated)](/prerelease/main/build/actions/arrow-tool/): Add an arrow to the canvas
- [Brush Tool](/prerelease/main/build/actions/brush-tool/): Paint freeform strokes on the canvas
- [Comment Tool](/prerelease/main/build/actions/comment-tool/): Allow users to comment on top of the stage content.
- [Connector Tool](/prerelease/main/build/actions/connector-tool/): Add connectors to the canvas
- [Ellipse Tool](/prerelease/main/build/actions/ellipse-tool/): Add an ellipse to the canvas
- [Eraser Tool](/prerelease/main/build/actions/eraser-tool/): Activate the deletion of nodes from the canvas
- [Export Node Tool](/prerelease/main/build/actions/export-node-tool/): Export the selected node as an image
- [Export Stage Tool](/prerelease/main/build/actions/export-stage-tool/): Export the entire stage (all nodes) node as an image
- [Fit to Screen Tool](/prerelease/main/build/actions/fit-to-screen-tool/): Set the zoom level so all the nodes on the stage are entirely visible on the screen
- [Fit to Selection Tool](/prerelease/main/build/actions/fit-to-selection-tool/): Set the zoom level so all the selected nodes are entirely visible on the screen
- [Frame Tool](/prerelease/main/build/actions/frame-tool/): Allows to add a canvas in canvas area
- [Image Tool](/prerelease/main/build/actions/image-tool/): Add an image to the canvas
- [Images Tool](/prerelease/main/build/actions/images-tool/): Add multiple images to the canvas
- [Actions](/prerelease/main/build/actions/): Actions maintained by Weave.js team
- [Line Tool (deprecated)](/prerelease/main/build/actions/line-tool/): Add a simple line to the canvas
- [Measure Tool](/prerelease/main/build/actions/measure-tool/): Add measures to the canvas
- [Move Tool](/prerelease/main/build/actions/move-tool/): Activate the panning or movement of the canvas
- [Pen Tool (deprecated)](/prerelease/main/build/actions/pen-tool/): Add line segments to the canvas
- [Polygon Tool](/prerelease/main/build/actions/polygon-tool/): Add a polygon to the canvas using a preset shape
- [Rectangle Tool](/prerelease/main/build/actions/rectangle-tool/): Add a rectangle to the canvas
- [Regular Polygon Tool (deprecated)](/prerelease/main/build/actions/regular-polygon-tool/): Add a regular polygon to the canvas
- [Selection Tool](/prerelease/main/build/actions/selection-tool/): Activate the selection of canvas nodes
- [Star Tool](/prerelease/main/build/actions/star-tool/): Add a star to the canvas
- [Stroke Tool](/prerelease/main/build/actions/stroke-tool/): Add a simple line to the canvas
- [Text Tool](/prerelease/main/build/actions/text-tool/): Add text to the canvas
- [Video Tool](/prerelease/main/build/actions/video-tool/): Add a video to the canvas
- [Zoom In Tool](/prerelease/main/build/actions/zoom-in-tool/): Increases one step the stage zoom level
- [Zoom Out Tool](/prerelease/main/build/actions/zoom-out-tool/): Decreases one step the stage zoom level
- [Arrow (deprecated)](/prerelease/main/build/nodes/arrow/): Draw an arrow on the canvas
- [Comment](/prerelease/main/build/nodes/comment/): Give feedback and collaborate with other users.
- [Connector](/prerelease/main/build/nodes/connector/): Draw a connected line between nodes
- [Ellipse](/prerelease/main/build/nodes/ellipse/): Draw an ellipse (or circle) on the canvas
- [Frame](/prerelease/main/build/nodes/frame/): Canvas-in-canvas element
- [Group](/prerelease/main/build/nodes/group/): Group nodes and manipulate them
- [Image](/prerelease/main/build/nodes/image/): Render images on the canvas
- [Nodes](/prerelease/main/build/nodes/): Nodes maintained by Weave.js team
- [Layer](/prerelease/main/build/nodes/layer/): Segment and order the Stage in layers
- [Line (deprecated)](/prerelease/main/build/nodes/line/): Draw a line on the canvas
- [Measure](/prerelease/main/build/nodes/measure/): Draw measure reference distance on the canvas
- [Polygon](/prerelease/main/build/nodes/polygon/): Draw a polygon on the canvas using a preset shape
- [Rectangle](/prerelease/main/build/nodes/rectangle/): Draw a rectangle on the canvas
- [Regular Polygon (deprecated)](/prerelease/main/build/nodes/regular-polygon/): Draw a regular polygon on the canvas
- [Stage](/prerelease/main/build/nodes/stage/): Main node to structure the canvas elements
- [Star](/prerelease/main/build/nodes/star/): Draw a star on the canvas
- [Stroke Single](/prerelease/main/build/nodes/stroke-single/): Draw a single-stroke line on the canvas
- [Stroke](/prerelease/main/build/nodes/stroke/): Draw a free-line on the canvas
- [Text](/prerelease/main/build/nodes/text/): Draw &amp; edit text on the canvas
- [Video](/prerelease/main/build/nodes/video/): Render a video on the canvas
- [Comments Renderer](/prerelease/main/build/plugins/comments-renderer/): Render the comments of a room in a special layer
- [Connected Users](/prerelease/main/build/plugins/connected-users/): Get an structure with information about the connected users
- [Context Menu](/prerelease/main/build/plugins/context-menu/): Trigger a contextual menu on the canvas
- [Copy &amp; Paste Nodes](/prerelease/main/build/plugins/copy-paste-nodes/): Activate support to copy &amp; paste the nodes
- [Plugins](/prerelease/main/build/plugins/): Plugins maintained by Weave.js team
- [Nodes Multi-selection Feedback](/prerelease/main/build/plugins/nodes-multi-selection-feedback/): Activate support to provide more feedback to the user when multi-selecting nodes
- [Nodes Selection](/prerelease/main/build/plugins/nodes-selection/): Activate support to select nodes on the canvas
- [Nodes Snapping](/prerelease/main/build/plugins/nodes-snapping/): Allow to snap nodes to guides and to themselves
- [Stage Drop Area](/prerelease/main/build/plugins/stage-drop-area/): Activate support to drop elements on the canvas
- [Stage Grid](/prerelease/main/build/plugins/stage-grid/): Renders a reference grid behind the nodes layer
- [Stage Keyboard Move](/prerelease/main/build/plugins/stage-keyboard-move/): Activates moving elements with shift + keyboard arrows
- [Stage minimap](/prerelease/main/build/plugins/stage-minimap/): Renders a minimap from the main stage
- [Stage Panning](/prerelease/main/build/plugins/stage-panning/): Activates the panning (move) of the stage
- [Stage Resize](/prerelease/main/build/plugins/stage-resize/): Activates the stage resizing (responsive support)
- [Stage Zoom](/prerelease/main/build/plugins/stage-zoom/): Activates support for zoom on the stage
- [Users Pointers](/prerelease/main/build/plugins/users-pointers/): Showcase the position of the users mouse pointer on the canvas
- [Users Presence](/prerelease/main/build/plugins/users-presence/): Showcase what the users are doing on the canvas
- [Users Selector](/prerelease/main/build/plugins/users-selector/): Showcase the selection of the users on the canvas
- [Azure Web PubSub](/prerelease/main/build/stores/azure-web-pubsub-store/): Store that uses Azure Web PubSub infrastructure as the transport layer
- [Stores](/prerelease/main/build/stores/): Stores maintained by Weave.js team
- [Standalone](/prerelease/main/build/stores/standalone-store/): Store that just renders a Weave.js room, useful for server-side image exporting
- [WebSockets](/prerelease/main/build/stores/websockets-store/): Store that uses the WebSockets API as the transport layer
